title: Register a UK establishment of an overseas company (OS IN01)
text:
Read how to complete form OS IN01 before you submit your form.

 It costs £124 to register a UK establishment of an overseas company.

 For more information on overseas companies, read our overseas companies guidance .

 Before you register

 All directors will need to verify their identity to prove who they are. You’ll need to give the Companies House personal code for each director and confirm they have verified their identity.

 See  Verifying your identity for Companies House .

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
changeNote: Updated fee to register a UK establishment of an overseas company.
